vocabulary.label: HELLO
vocabulary.actionSummary: Open palm salute outward from forehead/temple
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language greeting.

vocabulary.label: THANK_YOU
vocabulary.actionSummary: Fingertips from chin move forward and down toward person
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language sign for Thank You.

vocabulary.label: PLEASE
vocabulary.actionSummary: Open flat palm circular rub over chest
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language polite request gesture.

vocabulary.label: SORRY
vocabulary.actionSummary: Closed fist circular rub over center of chest
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language apology gesture.

vocabulary.label: YES
vocabulary.actionSummary: Closed fist nodding up and down like a head
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language affirmation gesture.

vocabulary.label: NO
vocabulary.actionSummary: Index and middle fingers tap against thumb like snapping beak
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language negation gesture.

vocabulary.label: HELP
vocabulary.actionSummary: Thumbs up fist on flat base palm lifted upward
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language assistance sign.

vocabulary.label: STOP
vocabulary.actionSummary: Dominant vertical open palm chops onto flat base palm
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language stop gesture.

vocabulary.label: WAIT
vocabulary.actionSummary: Palms upward with fingers wiggling gently in pause
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language wait gesture.

vocabulary.label: I
vocabulary.actionSummary: Index finger pointing directly to self / chest
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language first-person pronoun.

vocabulary.label: YOU
vocabulary.actionSummary: Index finger pointing directly outward to conversation partner
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language second-person pronoun.

vocabulary.label: WHAT
vocabulary.actionSummary: Both open hands palms up shaking side to side
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language inquiry sign.

vocabulary.label: WHERE
vocabulary.actionSummary: Index finger extended upright, waving side to side
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language location inquiry sign.

vocabulary.label: GO
vocabulary.actionSummary: Index fingers point forward and flick away in an arc
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language directional motion sign.

vocabulary.label: COME
vocabulary.actionSummary: Index fingers point outward and curl inward toward body
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language arrival motion sign.

vocabulary.label: EAT
vocabulary.actionSummary: Bunched fingertips brought to mouth repeatedly
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language eating sign.

vocabulary.label: DRINK
vocabulary.actionSummary: C-hand tipped toward mouth like holding a cup
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language drinking sign.

vocabulary.label: SLEEP
vocabulary.actionSummary: Both palms together under tilted cheek
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language resting/sleep sign.

vocabulary.label: HOME
vocabulary.actionSummary: Bunched fingertips touch mouth then cheek, or roof apex
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language home sign.

vocabulary.label: SCHOOL
vocabulary.actionSummary: Horizontal flat open palms clap together twice
vocabulary.description: Standard Indian Sign Language school sign.
